turns.content: How is a four-component Dirac spinor decomposed into two independent two-component Weyl sectors?
Which neutrino chirality is present in the minimal Standard Model field content?
Does the minimal Standard Model contain an independent right-handed neutrino singlet?
Define the component-counting convention for the neutrino Weyl sector that is actually present.
Apply that convention to the hypothetical Dirac decomposition and count the spinor components supplied by the minimal Standard Model.
State the count and identify the Weyl sector responsible for it.
Why does this bookkeeping neither add a right-handed neutrino nor imply that a massive Dirac neutrino belongs to the minimal Standard Model?
Report the component count with its field-content qualification.
